description: Origin-pinned, versioned set of allowed agent and project values and machine aliases for the universal thread naming convention <agent>-<project>-<machine>[-<task>]. The router validates a registration's router-constructed name against THIS schema read from origin/main of sirsi-pantheon; a working-tree copy never authorizes an identity (SSA C2). Adding or removing a value is a PROMOTION: a reviewed, owner/SSA-bound change to this file that bumps schema_version. The machine alias binds to the credentialed machine-id at runtime (SSA C3, ADR-067) and is never trusted from client-supplied hostname text.

m1.note: M1.local; alias bound to the credentialed machine-id at runtime (ADR-067)

m5.note: M5.local; alias bound to the credentialed machine-id at runtime (ADR-067)

task.note: Optional; the remainder after the third hyphen (SSA C1). Free-form within the grammar; not enumerated here.

promotion_authority: owner + SSA bind. A value is added only by a reviewed change to this file that bumps schema_version. The router reads this file from origin/main, never a working tree; a schema-hash mismatch is refused, never used to authorize an identity.
